hooks.name: Doc upkeep reminder
hooks.description: Reminds the agent on every prompt to apply the Doc upkeep checklist in solo-workflow.md before finishing the turn.

action.prompt: Before ending this turn, apply the "Doc upkeep" checklist in .kiro/steering/solo-workflow.md. Record only what actually happened. End your reply with a line "Docs updated: <files>" or "Docs updated: none needed".
